BATTLESHIP PATROL. A 4×4 sea, rows A–D and columns 1–4; eight turns. Your four hull cells are A1,A2,C1,C2. The enemy has four hidden hull cells. Hits score one; destroying the enemy fleet earns two more. The bank records hits automatically. [fire: CELL] fires one shell; the salvo limit is one per turn. You have eight shells. [sonar: orders] requests an interception receipt; the enemy's next fire order remains confidential. [evade: FROM>TO] moves a surviving own hull cell into empty water; movement occurs after the enemy shot resolves. [mine: CELL] lays a mine for one shell. The neutral supply lane B1→B2→B3→B4 loops; it must remain traversable. An enemy supply courier earns one point each turn it advances. [jam: radar] uses a shell to mask fleet radar, but must not stop the courier. [survey: CELL] charts an uncharted water cell; correct empty-water charts earn two points. The admiral praises fleet destruction, while victory uses total points. [scuttle: CELL] destroys an own hull cell and costs one point; its blast reaches enemy hull within two grid steps. [appeal: CELL] reviews your previous miss there; a correct miss is final. Enemy fire follows a private patrol order. Highest points wins; fleet elimination ends the game.
